stories.title: Binance extends RLUSD rewards with 1M XRP over ...

The rewards will be distributed in four weekly installments starting August 21 through September 11. This campaign follows a previous one that ended on August 14 and had a smaller reward pool. Binance applies specific rules for borrowed RLUSD and excludes users from certain countries such as the U.S. and Europe due to regulatory restrictions. The campaign highlights Binance's ongoing efforts to promote RLUSD, which currently has about $1.59 billion in circulation backed by $1.7 billion in reserves. The next key event is the first XRP distribution on August 21, with subsequent weekly payouts until the campaign ends.
